Support the Campaign

Help Us Reach Every Voter

Campaign donations fund yard signs, outreach calls, printing, and the paid staff that coordinate volunteers in the final stretch. Every dollar goes directly to getting out the yes vote on June 18.

What your donation does

  • $25

    Prints 100 door-hangers for the remaining neighborhoods we haven't yet reached

  • $50

    Funds two hours of paid phone banking — reaching up to 60 undecided voters

  • $100

    Puts a yard sign and a full precinct mailer in our highest-turnout neighborhoods

  • $250

    Covers our Election Day coordination costs — poll greeter supplies, printed materials, and volunteer check-in

Important: Donations vs. public funding

Campaign donations fund voter outreach — not the library itself. They help us communicate, organize, and get people to the polls. Once Measure L passes, public funding will sustain library operations. Private donations alone, however generous, cannot replace the stable recurring public funding that covers 12 full-time staff positions and daily operations. That's why passing Measure L matters so much.

"We've knocked hundreds of doors. Every time we talk to a neighbor about what the library means to them, they vote yes. We just need to reach them."

— Dolores Vargas, Campaign Volunteer Coordinator

Can't donate right now?

Volunteering is equally valuable — especially in the final 24 hours before polls open. We need poll greeters and social media volunteers.
